name: net-net-clearance
prompt: Add a 0.25 mm power-to-ground clearance rule, source: skill example 0.25 mm above the substrate fabrication floor, then build, capture, and measure the realized copper between two code-authored routes placed closer than the rule. Also test a 0.05 mm request, source: skill test value 0.05 mm intentionally below the substrate fabrication floor, and record what the copper does.

inputs.notes: The JLCPCB copper spacing floor is read from JLCPCBRules.min_copper_copper_space, jitxlib/jlcpcb/rules.py:9. The capture check excludes pours because captured Pour geometry is the input outline before runtime voiding.
inputs.environment: Commands run from the repository root with python3 resolving to the project interpreter that has jitx installed.

expected_output: A design module with module-scope power and ground tags, four structural board defaults, a priority 2 two-condition clearance rule, and two pad-to-point routes authored closer together than the rule (and, in a variant, closer than the fabrication floor). A check script submits and captures each design, verifies route realization and trace widths, measures power-to-ground copper clearance, and asserts the observed behavior: realized clearance equals the authored gap, the clearance rule does not move code-authored routes, and the floor is not enforced on them either, all with status ok. NOTES.md records the real commands and output.

assertions.text: the pure helper unit tests pass
the shipped helper and reference module type-check against the installed JITX package
the built and captured reference checks pass
the 0.25 mm clearance value is labeled on its line as the skill example above the JLCPCB floor read from the substrate
NOTES.md records that neither the 0.05 mm rule nor JLCPCBRules.min_copper_copper_space moved the authored routes, and that statement matches the captured copper
the reference states that clearance rules act on router-generated copper and pour voiding, and that code-authored routes must be placed with the clearance already satisfied and checked after capture
